chunks.heading: Who he is
chunks.text:
# About Darshan Tandel
## Who he is
Darshan Tandel is a Full Stack Developer based in Valsad, Gujarat, India. He builds scalable
React and Next.js applications, large WordPress platforms, and local/offline AI and RAG tools.
He is currently open to work.

chunks.heading: Elevator pitch
chunks.text:
# About Darshan Tandel
## Elevator pitch
Darshan works across the stack: React.js, Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend; Node.js,
Express.js, PHP and WordPress on the backend; MongoDB and MySQL for data. Alongside product
work, he explores applied AI — retrieval-augmented generation and local LLMs served with
Ollama — and has shipped a fully offline AI chatbot as a personal project. His most substantial
production work is the Pushtimarg WordPress platform, where he single-handedly built 13+ custom
plugins and a custom theme, including a from-scratch English/Hindi translation engine.

chunks.heading: Why hire Darshan
chunks.text:
# About Darshan Tandel
## Why hire Darshan
He has shipped real production systems solo — not tutorial projects. The Pushtimarg platform
(13+ plugins, custom theme, OAuth, multilingual engine, LMS) and the FOP Admin Dashboard
(14 components, 17 custom hooks across 13 pages, built and owned end-to-end) both show he can
take a project from requirements to a working, maintained product. He also mentors other
developers, and is actively building AI engineering skills (RAG, local LLMs, embeddings) on top
of a solid full-stack foundation — someone who keeps learning past what the job strictly requires.

chunks.heading: Pushtimarg Web Application

# Projects
## Pushtimarg Web Application
A scalable WordPress platform built from 13+ custom plugins and a custom theme. Features a
from-scratch English/Hindi multilingual system, an LMS with quizzes and progress tracking,
OAuth login (Google, Facebook, Microsoft), and REST API integrations. This is Darshan's
largest and most featured production project, built at Wappzo Infotech.

Live: https://pushtimarg.wappzo.com
Metrics: 13+ plugins, custom theme, EN/HI translation engine.

chunks.heading: FOP Admin Dashboard (Food Ordering Platform)
chunks.text:
# Projects
## FOP Admin Dashboard (Food Ordering Platform)
A restaurant operations dashboard built solo by Darshan — 14 components and 17 custom hooks
built in an MVVM pattern, used to manage, track, and report on food items, orders, and
categories across 13 pages.
Tags: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs.
Metrics: 14 components, 17 custom hooks, 13 pages.

chunks.heading: Local AI Chatbot
chunks.text:
# Projects
## Local AI Chatbot
An offline AI chatbot integrating Ollama with 4 swappable open-source LLMs: Llama 3.2, Mistral,
Gemma, and DeepSeek-R1. Supports persistent multi-turn conversation history and real-time
token streaming, running entirely locally with zero API cost.
Tags: Python, Streamlit, Ollama, LLMs.
Metrics: 4 models, fully offline, streaming responses.

Note: this portfolio's own AI assistant (the chat widget you're using right now) is a separate,
newer project — a Next.js/TypeScript RAG-based assistant also powered by local Ollama models,
built specifically to help recruiters navigate this portfolio.
